observation_method: Authenticated owner Post Analytics panel, transcribed from accessibility text. Capture interval bounded by local UTC timestamps; observed_at is capture completion.
limitations: Panel totals have no organic/promoted split. Own views can count. Replies may include own thread continuations. No inference of independent engagement.
